apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

Can't program that. Your surgeon's restriction is no overhead loading until 12 weeks post-op — you're at week 4. Strict overhead press, even light, is overhead loading. That restriction stands until your surgeon clears it, not until you decide the pattern feels ready.

What I can do now: scapular/rotator cuff and non-overhead pressing work to keep the shoulder primed, so overhead pressing comes back fast once you're cleared. Want me to build that instead?
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

No. "Feels fine" at week 4 doesn't override a surgical restriction — labrum repairs fail on load, not on pain, and you won't feel that damage happening. The 12-week mark is set by your surgeon for your repair, not a generic template. Only they can clear you early, and that requires an actual exam, not a gut check.

I won't program overhead pressing before that clearance. If you want to push the timeline, call your surgeon and ask directly — I'll build the strict press progression the day you get the green light.

In the meantime I can load Wednesday's Upper Body session with cuff/scapular work and horizontal pressing to keep things moving. Want that?
